The global configuration object

Source: R/config_objects.R
config.Rd

config gives upstream's config.name access to the settings of manim_config(): config$frame_height, config$pixel_width <- 1280, config[["background_color"]]. Derived values (frame_width, frame_x_radius, frame_y_radius, aspect_ratio, top, bottom, left_side, right_side) are computed on read; frame_width can also be set, as upstream allows, and then stays fixed until set again. config$quality <- "low_quality" applies a preset from QUALITIES. Three of upstream's methods are there too: config$digest_file(path) reads a manim.cfg file (digest_config_file()), config$get_dir(key, ...) resolves a directory setting (get_dir()) and config$update(list(...)) changes several settings.

Usage

config

# S3 method for class 'manim_config_object'
x$name

# S3 method for class 'manim_config_object'
x[[i, ...]]

# S3 method for class 'manim_config_object'
x$name <- value

# S3 method for class 'manim_config_object'
x[[i]] <- value

# S3 method for class 'manim_config_object'
names(x)

# S3 method for class 'manim_config_object'
print(x, ...)

manim_frame

# S3 method for class 'manim_frame_object'
x$name

# S3 method for class 'manim_frame_object'
x[[i, ...]]

# S3 method for class 'manim_frame_object'
x$name <- value

# S3 method for class 'manim_frame_object'
x[[i]] <- value

# S3 method for class 'manim_frame_object'
names(x)

# S3 method for class 'manim_frame_object'
print(x, ...)

tempconfig(temp, code)

Arguments

x

A config object.

name, i

A setting name.

...

Ignored.

value

New value.

temp

A named list of settings.

code

Code to run with those settings.

Value

tempconfig() returns the value of code.

Details

manim_frame is upstream's read only frame object: the frame sizes and edges plus the direction constants (manim_frame$top, manim_frame$UP). It is not called frame because that would mask graphics::frame().

tempconfig() runs code with some settings changed and restores them afterwards, like upstream's with tempconfig({...}): block. As upstream, names that are not settings are ignored.

Examples

config$frame_height
#> [1] 8
tempconfig(list(frame_height = 100), config$frame_height)
#> [1] 100
manim_frame$right_side
#> [1] 7.111111 0.000000 0.000000
